column3: OBJ_RELOCS row 4 words; word2 ref<1000 = section index (.bss), ref>=1000 = named symbol id (1000+id, via POS); named relocs already supported for externs
x86 ELF relocation capture net (was x86object.py) decides ref; process-region refs currently land as .bss+off
arm64 has its own capture net also writing OBJ_RELOCS; same fact must change or arm64 stays anonymous
symbols region pre-packed by objectplan; both direct_labels d1 and offset-table d0 branches need COMMON rows (shndx 0xfff2 value=8 size=8)
writer copies packed words; no change needed if objectplan packs COMMON
posix C.processargs ADDR argsave offset 48 (whole-program); in -funit object slot is bss tail -0x78/-0x70 (4 samples only)
osx/win -funit objects carry only unit tapes (REJECT not covered), no native reloc; not affected now, but must follow same naming when native objects land
RT_EXTERN tentative def emitted as strong def; COMMON needs frontend tentative-definition semantics, separate layer
no SHN_COMMON merge yet; needed for objlink path
